messages.text: Ticket #4821 from Priya Shah: her order arrived without the V60 filters. Tagged it missing item, normal priority. @Answerer
Drafted a reply from the Shipping page: we're sending the filters today, no return needed, tracking by tomorrow. It's an internal note on the ticket for you to check.
Sent, and set the ticket to pending.
Ticket #1193 asks for a refund of $86 on a subscription renewed yesterday. The Refunds page allows it within 14 days. I haven't replied. Should I tell them it's refunded once you've done it?
@Answerer refunded. Tell them, and say sorry for the trouble.
